sentences.en: OBJECTIVE:To investigate the diagnostics value of combining telome rase activity with CEA levels in differentiating malignant from nonmalignant pleural effusion.

sentences.en: None was WT1 positive in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (MNC) from 29 blood donors, while bone marrow MNCs from eight of 21 cases (38.1%) of nonmalignant patient WT1 gene expression were found.
